data.name: El Velo: Hell Has No Limits
data.detailed_description:
After a child goes missing, you are sent to investigate a case that seems connected to something far more disturbing than a simple crime. Explore abandoned places, follow fragmented evidence, and uncover the truth behind a supernatural mystery where reality cannot always be trusted.

Investigate the unknown

Search through isolated locations and examine your surroundings for clues. Every object, recording, and piece of evidence may reveal something about the disappearance, the people involved, and the darkness hidden beneath the case.

Solve environmental puzzles

Use the evidence you find to interpret your surroundings and progress through each investigation. The puzzles are connected to the world, the case, and the fragmented memories surrounding it.

Face horror without combat

There are no weapons to rely on. Survival depends on observation, caution, and knowing when to hide or escape. Something is watching from the darkness, and confronting it may not be an option.

Reality keeps changing

Each run can alter the layout of locations, the clues you discover, and the events you encounter. Explore carefully, connect the evidence, and piece together a story that becomes more disturbing with every attempt.

Key Features

  • First-person psychological horror.

  • A supernatural police thriller set in 1990s rural Mexico.

  • Exploration-focused gameplay with no direct combat.

  • Environmental puzzles connected to the investigation.

  • Modular roguelite mechanics and changing runs.

  • Procedurally rearranged locations, clues, and events.

  • Found-footage VHS-inspired visual style.

  • A narrative about disappearance, guilt, corruption, and trauma.

  • Multiple discoveries that gradually reveal the truth.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-1245U or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe Graphics or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror, disturbing imagery, depictions of violence, blood, corpses, child disappearance, crime scenes, death, trauma, and themes of guilt and corruption. It may also include frightening environments, stalking, intense peril, and implied abuse. There is no sexual content or nudity.
